snippet.title: Unreal But True
snippet.description:
What if the impossible actually happened? A new space what-if every day at 5:48 pm (Riyadh). Black holes, neutron stars, a Moon that falls, an Earth that stops spinning: real science, played out second by second.
Subscribe so tomorrow's what-if finds you.
